title: Operation
summary: An operation combines permitted inputs according to a single-valued rule.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared structural mathematics context is fixed.

content.plain: An operation combines permitted inputs according to a single-valued rule.
content.exact: An n-ary operation on X is a function ω:Xⁿ→X. Partial and multi-valued operations require different declarations.
content.example: Integer addition is a binary operation +:ℤ×ℤ→ℤ.
content.caveat: Closure, arity, and domain are part of the operation; they are not decoration.
